summary.text: Captain of the Athenians, called the son of Sphelus son of Bucolus, whom Aeneas slew beside Medon in the battle at the ships — a namesake of Iasus king of Argos, of Atalanta's father in Arcadia, and of other Iasus figures in later myth.

story.text: When Apollo roused the Trojans and the fight turned grim about the hollow ships, Aeneas slew Medon the bastard son of Oileus and Iasus, a captain of the Athenians who was called the son of Sphelus, son of Bucolus.
